electricity.inventory_change: Regional electricity markets and power-generation datasets
electricity.downstream_effect: Every activity consuming electricity inherits the transformed background
electricity.not_changed: The IAM does not directly replace every exchange or foreground process

dac.iam_input: Scenario-dependent DAC/CDR deployment and cumulative deployment
dac.inventory_change: Scenario-specific solvent- and sorbent-based DAC inventories
dac.downstream_effect: Energy, materials and infrastructure requirements alter LCIA results
dac.not_changed: Deployment volume is not itself an LCIA score and missing deployment rows are not automatically zero

steel.iam_input: Regional steel production volumes and route shares
steel.derived_parameter: Primary, secondary, CCS and hydrogen-route market shares
steel.inventory_change: Regional steel markets and route-specific production datasets
steel.downstream_effect: Steel-intensive products inherit scenario-specific energy and process burdens
steel.not_changed: The IAM route taxonomy is mapped to, rather than copied into, ecoinvent activities

transport.iam_input: Fleet technology shares, energy use and efficiency pathways
transport.derived_parameter: Powertrain shares and scenario-specific vehicle performance
transport.inventory_change: Vehicle production, operation and fuel-supply datasets
transport.downstream_effect: Passenger and freight services inherit vehicle and energy-system changes
transport.not_changed: A fleet share is not a direct replacement for a foreground mobility demand

cement.iam_input: Cement production, kiln energy and CCS pathways
cement.derived_parameter: Kiln-route shares, efficiency and capture parameters
cement.downstream_effect: Buildings and infrastructure inherit scenario-specific cement burdens
cement.not_changed: Foreground material quantities remain part of the LCA study definition
